newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dayton Mining EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dayton Mining EPS view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it lowered its 1996 earnings estimates for Dayton Mining Corp to a loss of $0.04 a share from a profit of $0.13.
-- Analyst Todd Hinrichs said blast problems which the company thought it had overcome reemerged in November. As a result, higher-than-expected costs were posted during the fourth quarter, he said.
-- EVEREN continues to rate the stock an outperform for both the near and long term.
-- Shares of Dayton Mining traded unchanged at 7.75 on the Toronto exchange.
